words.defn_en: one to whom you confide your secrets:

sentences.zh: 她一直是他最親密的知己,一個他完全信任的人。

sentences.en: He shared his biggest secret with his most trusted ______.
sentences.zh: 他把最大的秘密告訴了他最信任的知己。

words.defn_en: feeling sure or self-assured:

sentences.en: Michael Jordan is ______ in his abilities as a basketball player.
sentences.zh: 麥可喬丹對自己身為籃球員的能力充滿信心。

sentences.en: She felt ______ enough to give the presentation without notes.
sentences.zh: 她自信滿滿,足以不看筆記就完成這場簡報。

words.defn_en: to arrange or set up something in a particular way:

sentences.en: You need to ______ the software settings before use.
sentences.zh: 你必須在使用前先設定好這套軟體。

sentences.en: The technician helped him ______ the new router at home.
sentences.zh: 技術人員協助他在家中設定這台新路由器。

words.defn_en: firmly established in a habit or belief; verified as true:

sentences.en: He remained a ______ bachelor well into his sixties.
sentences.zh: 他一直到六十多歲仍是個死心塌地的單身漢。

sentences.en: Officials issued a statement once the outbreak was ______.
sentences.zh: 疫情確認後,官方隨即發布了聲明。

words.defn_en: burning fiercely; ablaze:

sentences.en: Firefighters could see the ______ building from three miles away.
sentences.zh: 消防隊員在三英里外就能看見這棟熊熊燃燒的建築。

sentences.en: The ______ forest lit up the night sky for miles around.
sentences.zh: 這片熊熊燃燒的森林,將方圓數英里的夜空照得通紅。

words.defn_en: great fire:

sentences.en: Dry winds turned the small brush fire into a massive ______.
sentences.zh: 乾燥的強風將這場小型灌木叢火災變成了一場巨大的火災。

sentences.en: The ______ destroyed dozens of buildings before firefighters brought it under control.
sentences.zh: 在消防員將火勢控制住之前,這場大火已摧毀了數十棟建築物。

words.defn_en: to combine two or more things into one, sometimes mistakenly:

sentences.en: News reports mistakenly began to ______ the two separate incidents.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導開始誤將這兩起原本各自獨立的事件混為一談。

sentences.en: The editor warned against ______ing correlation with causation in the study's summary.
sentences.zh: 編輯提醒不要在這份研究摘要中,將相關性與因果關係混為一談。

words.defn_en: combined in a misleading way:

sentences.en: The two issues were ______ in the argument.
sentences.zh: 這兩個議題在這場爭論中被混淆合併在一起。

sentences.en: Many people have ______ the two historical events, though they are unrelated.
sentences.zh: 許多人將這兩個歷史事件混為一談,儘管它們其實毫不相關。

words.defn_en: the act of combining two or more things into one, sometimes mistakenly:

sentences.en: The lawsuit hinges on a ______ of two very different legal concepts.
sentences.zh: 這起訴訟的關鍵,在於混淆了兩個截然不同的法律概念。

sentences.en: Critics pointed out the ______ of the two historical figures in the film's script.
sentences.zh: 評論家指出,這部電影劇本混淆了這兩位歷史人物。

words.defn_en: a gathering together:

sentences.en: The city was built at the ______ of two great rivers.
sentences.zh: 這座城市建在兩條大河的匯流處。

sentences.en: Her success was the result of a rare ______ of talent and opportunity.
sentences.zh: 她的成功是天賦與機運難得匯聚的結果。

words.defn_en: to comply with rules or expectations:

sentences.en: The alternative rocker refuses to ______ to societal norms.
sentences.zh: 這位另類搖滾歌手拒絕順從社會的規範。

sentences.en: New employees are expected to ______ to the company's dress code.
sentences.zh: 新進員工被要求遵守公司的服裝規定。

words.defn_en: one who behaves the same as others:

sentences.en: Unlike his rebellious classmates, he was seen as a quiet ______.
sentences.zh: 與叛逆的同學不同,他被視為安分守己的順從者。

sentences.en: The school discouraged individuality, favoring students who were ______s.
sentences.zh: 這所學校不鼓勵個人特色,偏好循規蹈矩的學生。

words.defn_en: to frustrate, confuse:

sentences.en: The magician's trick continued to ______ the audience.
sentences.zh: 這位魔術師的把戲讓觀眾持續感到困惑不解。

sentences.en: Her sudden decision to quit ______ed everyone at the company.
sentences.zh: 她突然辭職的決定讓公司裡的每個人都感到困惑。

words.defn_en: puzzling; baffling

sentences.en: The sudden drop in sales was ______ to the entire marketing team.
sentences.zh: 銷售額突然暴跌,讓整個行銷團隊感到困惑不解。

sentences.en: Scientists found the results ______ and difficult to explain.
sentences.zh: 科學家發現這些結果令人困惑,難以解釋。

words.defn_en: to come face-to-face with:

sentences.en: She decided to ______ her fears by going skydiving.
sentences.zh: 她決定去跳傘,以直面自己的恐懼。

sentences.en: He finally worked up the courage to ______ his rival about the rumors.
sentences.zh: 他終於鼓起勇氣去找對手當面對質這些謠言。

words.defn_en: to cause someone to be unable to understand clearly:

sentences.en: The conflicting instructions began to ______ even the most experienced staff.
sentences.zh: 這些互相矛盾的指示,連經驗最豐富的員工都開始感到困惑。

sentences.en: Don't ______ enthusiasm with actual expertise.
sentences.zh: 別把熱情和真正的專業能力混為一談。

words.defn_en: to thicken into a solid:

sentences.en: The leftover gravy had ______ed into a solid mass overnight.
sentences.zh: 剩下的肉汁隔夜後已經凝固成一團固體。

sentences.en: Cold air caused the wax to ______ around the candle's base.
sentences.zh: 冷空氣使蠟油在蠟燭底部凝結成塊。

words.defn_en: sympathetic, agreeable:

sentences.en: The staff at the small inn were warm and ______.
sentences.zh: 這家小旅館的員工既熱情又意氣相投。

sentences.en: She found her new coworkers to be friendly and ______.
sentences.zh: 她發現新同事既友善又合得來。

words.defn_en: present at birth but not necessarily hereditary:

sentences.en: The infant was diagnosed with a rare ______ heart defect.
sentences.zh: 這名嬰兒被診斷出患有一種罕見的先天性心臟缺陷。

sentences.en: Doctors monitored the baby closely for any ______ conditions.
sentences.zh: 醫生密切觀察這名嬰兒是否有任何先天性病症。

words.defn_en: a mass of different things gathered together:

sentences.en: The attic held a strange ______ of old toys, letters, and broken furniture.
sentences.zh: 這間閣樓堆滿了一堆舊玩具、信件與壞掉的家具,雜亂無章。

sentences.en: The city grew into a sprawling ______ of neighborhoods with no clear center.
sentences.zh: 這座城市發展成一大片雜亂延伸的社區聚合體,沒有明確的中心。

words.defn_en: to gather together into a crowd or group:

sentences.en: Fans began to ______ outside the stadium hours before the game.
sentences.zh: 球迷們在比賽開始前好幾個小時就開始聚集在體育場外。

sentences.en: Birds would ______ near the lake each evening at dusk.
sentences.zh: 鳥兒們每天傍晚都會聚集在這座湖泊附近。

words.defn_en: a gathering of people, especially for religious services:

sentences.en: The ______ sang together as the sun set over the church.
sentences.zh: 當夕陽在教堂上空落下時,會眾一同歌唱。

sentences.en: The new pastor addressed his ______ for the first time on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 這位新牧師在週日首次向他的會眾講道。

words.defn_en: in agreement or harmony; identical in shape and size (geometry):

sentences.zh: 她的行為終於與她宣揚的價值觀一致了。

sentences.en: The two triangles are ______ , with all corresponding sides and angles equal.
sentences.zh: 這兩個三角形是全等的,對應的邊與角皆相等。

words.defn_en: the quality of being in agreement:

sentences.en: Editors checked the manuscript for ______ between the timeline and the plot.
sentences.zh: 編輯檢查了這份手稿的時間軸與情節是否一致。

sentences.en: There was a striking ______ between her values and her actions.
sentences.zh: 她的價值觀與行為之間有著驚人的一致性。

words.defn_en: appropriate or in agreement with something:

sentences.zh: 這棟現代增建的部分,經過設計以與這座歷史建築的風格相協調。

sentences.en: His calm response was entirely ______ with his usual demeanor.
sentences.zh: 他鎮定的回應,完全符合他一貫的作風。

words.defn_en: guess:

sentences.zh: 在沒有任何實際證據的情況下,他的理論仍只是純粹的推測。

sentences.en: Scientists made a ______ about the planet's composition based on limited data.
sentences.zh: 科學家根據有限的數據對這顆行星的組成做出了推測。

words.defn_en: relating to marriage:

sentences.zh: 這對夫妻在他過世前享有數十年美滿的婚姻生活。

sentences.en: Prisoners in some facilities are allowed brief ______ visits.
sentences.zh: 在某些機構中,受刑人可獲准短暫的夫妻探視。

words.defn_en: to plot, scheme:

sentences.zh: 調查人員認為這名職員與外部人士共謀偷竊資金。

words.defn_en: expert:

sentences.zh: 他自認是一位美酒鑑賞行家。

sentences.en: As a ______ of classical music, she rarely missed a symphony performance.
sentences.zh: 身為古典音樂的行家,她幾乎不會錯過任何一場交響樂演出。

sentences.zh: cheap(便宜)這個字比 inexpensive(經濟實惠)帶有更負面的隱含意義。

sentences.zh: 作家必須同時考量每個用字的字面意義與隱含意義。

words.defn_en: to suggest or imply an idea beyond its literal meaning:

sentences.zh: 紅色依情境不同,可以隱含危險、熱情或慶祝之意。

sentences.en: Her tone seemed to ______ disapproval, even though her words were neutral.
sentences.zh: 儘管她的用詞中立,她的語氣卻似乎隱含著不贊同。

words.defn_en: related to marriage:=Conjugal

sentences.zh: 這對夫妻共同享有數十年美滿的婚姻幸福。

sentences.zh: 他們的婚姻情感隨著時間變得越來越堅固。

sentences.zh: 她終於成功戰勝了自己對公開演講的恐懼。

sentences.en: Marriage laws in most countries restrict unions based on close ______.
sentences.zh: 大多數國家的婚姻法都會依血緣關係的親近程度來限制婚配。

words.defn_en: an inner sense of right and wrong that guides behavior:

sentences.en: Her ______ wouldn't let her keep the extra change the cashier gave her.
sentences.zh: 她的良心不允許她把收銀員多找的零錢留下來。

sentences.en: He confessed out of a guilty ______ .

sentences.zh: 這位認真負責的學生在交卷前把每個答案都檢查了一遍。

sentences.zh: 他以認真負責、從不錯過截止期限的員工形象聞名。

sentences.zh: 在物資短缺時收取這麼高的價格,這樣做真的合乎良心嗎?

sentences.zh: 這家公司堅稱他們的勞動作法完全合乎道德良心。

words.defn_en: to dedicate something to a holy purpose:

sentences.zh: 主教前來為這座新落成的大教堂進行奉獻儀式。

sentences.zh: 這片土地被奉為紀念陣亡士兵的聖地。

words.defn_en: the act of formally dedicating something to a sacred purpose:
words.root_note: con- (thoroughly) + sacrare (to make sacred), from Latin

sentences.zh: 這位主教主持了這座新建大教堂的祝聖儀式。

sentences.en: Her ______ to the cause left no room for personal ambition.
sentences.zh: 她對這項志業全心的奉獻,已經容不下任何個人的野心。

words.defn_en: general agreement:

sentences.zh: 團隊終於就這項決定達成了共識。

sentences.en: Scientists have reached a broad ______ on the causes of climate change.
sentences.zh: 科學家們對氣候變遷的成因已達成廣泛的共識。

words.defn_en: permission for something to happen; to give permission:

sentences.zh: 沒有病人的書面同意,這場手術無法進行。

sentences.zh: 經過好幾個月的討論,她的父母終於同意了這趟海外旅行。

words.defn_en: as a result; therefore:

sentences.zh: 工廠提前關閉;因此,數十名工人因而失業。

sentences.en: He missed the deadline and, ______ , lost the contract entirely.
sentences.zh: 他錯過了截止期限,結果因此完全失去了這份合約。

words.defn_en: careful thought about something; thoughtfulness toward others:

sentences.en: After much ______ , she decided to accept the job offer.
sentences.zh: 經過再三考量後,她決定接受這份工作邀約。

sentences.en: His ______ for his elderly neighbor never went unnoticed.
sentences.zh: 他對年邁鄰居的體貼,從未被人忽略。

words.defn_en: to give something over to another's care:

sentences.en: She had no choice but to ______ her belongings to a storage unit.
sentences.zh: 她別無選擇,只能把物品託付給倉儲空間保管。

sentences.en: The old letters were ______ed to the museum's archive.
sentences.zh: 這些舊信件被託付給博物館的檔案室保存。

words.defn_en: acting in the same way over time:

sentences.en: My grandmother's knitting is always ______ in quality.
sentences.zh: 我祖母的編織作品品質總是十分一致穩定。

sentences.en: The referee's calls were not ______ throughout the game.
sentences.zh: 裁判在整場比賽中的判決並不一致。

words.defn_en: an act of comforting:

sentences.zh: 輸掉這場比賽後,她唯一的安慰就是觀眾的掌聲。

sentences.en: He offered words of ______ to the grieving family.
sentences.zh: 他向這個悲痛的家庭致上安慰之詞。

words.defn_en: to comfort someone in distress; a control panel or cabinet:

sentences.en: She tried to ______ her friend after the difficult breakup.
sentences.zh: 她試著在朋友經歷艱難的分手後安慰她。

sentences.en: The pilot checked every switch on the cockpit ______ before takeoff.
sentences.zh: 飛行員在起飛前檢查了駕駛艙控制台上的每個開關。

words.defn_en: agreement or harmony between things; repetition of consonant sounds in poetry:

sentences.en: The new policy was crafted in ______ with the company's stated values.
sentences.zh: 這項新政策是依循公司宣示的價值觀,協調一致地制定的。

sentences.en: The poet used ______ , repeating the "t" sound, to create a clipped, tense rhythm.
sentences.zh: 詩人運用子音韻,重複「t」音,營造出短促緊張的節奏。

words.defn_en: in harmony:

sentences.en: Her actions were entirely ______ with the values she preached.
sentences.zh: 她的行為與她所宣揚的價值觀完全一致。

sentences.en: The new policy is ______ with the company's long-term goals.
sentences.zh: 這項新政策與公司的長期目標一致。

words.defn_en: a general survey or summary of a subject:

sentences.zh: 這篇導言在深入細節之前,先提供了整個領域實用的概覽。

sentences.en: Her lecture served as a ______ of twentieth-century art movements.
sentences.zh: 她的講座是一場對二十世紀藝術流派的綜覽。
